_what: The exact interpreter and library this reference run used. A reproducer matching these is testing the pipeline; a reproducer NOT matching them is testing something more interesting, and both are wanted.
_limit: ⚠ THIS IS A RECORD, NOT A LOCK. A real lock pins wheel hashes and an installer enforces them. numpy ships different BLAS builds per platform and per wheel, and the BLAS is the thing that actually matters here -- so the fields below that decide the result are the OpenBLAS build and the SELECTED KERNEL, neither of which a requirements file can pin. They are recorded per run in run.json instead. Calling this a lock would be the kind of overstatement this study exists to measure.
does_not_require: threadpoolctl (used if present, recorded as absent if not)
